description: Compact workflow plus verbatim rules; v48 base names and derived-object names require complete independent antecedents, preserving mathematical/statistical qualifiers, actual head span and object identity. Source-supported base-reference plus an explicit operation is distinct from naming a derived object; no automatic split on de, invented definitions, dropped qualifiers or substring passes. Sync claims/solution and valid counts in existing checks. All v45/v43/v44 and earlier limits retained; source edits require renewed coverage review.
